Seth addresses the Trump administration asking the Supreme Court to allow it to resume construction on the border wall and more in his monologue for Thursday, October 22, before taking a closer look at widespread bipartisan outrage over a despicable GOP ad in Ohio and Trump's new argument for why people should vote GOP.
